examples.text: na brāhmaṇo kappam'upeti saṅkhā, na diṭṭhisārī na'pi ñāṇabandhu, ñatvā ca so sammutiyo puthujjā, upekkhatī uggahaṇanti m'aññe.

28876.meaning1: modicum of partial knowledge; measure of incomplete understanding
28876.commentary: (MNa) tattha ñāṇabhāgamattam'eva pariyodapentī'ti mayam'idaṃ jānāmā'ti evaṃ tattha ñāṇakoṭṭhāsaṃ otārenti'y'eva.

examples.text: paccattaṃ kho pana, bhikkhave, ñāṇe asati parisuddhe pariyodāte yadapi te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā tattha ñāṇabhāgamattam'eva pariyodapenti tadapi tesaṃ bhavataṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ upādānam'akkhāyati.

28877.meaning1: with understanding; (comm) who has known the causes

examples.text: so h'āvuso, bhagavā jānaṃ jānāti, passaṃ passati, cakkhubhūto ñāṇabhūto dhammabhūto brahmabhūto, vattā pavattā, atthassa ninnetā, amatassa dātā, dhammassāmī tathāgato

28878.commentary: (DNa) atha kho yāva'd'eva ñāṇamattāya apar'āparaṃ uttaruttari ñāṇapamāṇ'atthāya c'eva satipamāṇ'atthāya ca, satisampajaññānaṃ vuḍḍh'atthāyā'ti attho.

examples.text: atthi kāyo'ti vā pan'assa sati paccupaṭṭhitā hoti yāva'd'eva ñāṇamattāya paṭissatimattāya anissito ca viharati na ca kiñci loke upādiyati

28879.grammar: fem, comp, dat sg of ñāṇamattā
28879.meaning1: for a measure of understanding; enough for knowledge
28879.meaning2: for a measure of understanding; enough for knowledge

examples.text: atthi kāyo'ti vā pan'assa sati paccupaṭṭhitā hoti yāva'd'eva ñāṇamattāya paṭissatimattāya anissito ca viharati, na ca kiñci loke upādiyati. evam'pi kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāye kāy'ānupassī viharati.

28880.meaning1: accomplished in understanding; skilled in insight; who has understanding

examples.text: ye te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū sīlasampannā samādhisampannā ñāṇasampannā vimuttisampannā vimuttiñāṇadassanasampannā, dassanam'p'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bahukāraṃ vadāmi

28881.meaning1: associated with understanding; connected with knowledge
28881.commentary: (ADha) ñāṇasampayuttan'ti ñāṇena sampayuttaṃ, samaṃ ek'uppād'ādippakārehi yuttan'ti attho.

examples.text: vipassī-ādayo pana sabbe'pi bodhisattā mettāpubbabhāgena somanassasahagata-ñāṇasampayutta-asaṅkhārikacittena mātukucchismiṃ paṭisandhiṃ gaṇhiṃsu. tena cittena gahitāya paṭisandhiyā asaṅkhyeyyaṃ āyu, iti sabbe buddhā asaṅkhyeyy'āyukā.
gatisampattiyā ñāṇasampayutte katinaṃ hetūnaṃ paccayā upapatti hoti?

28882.meaning1: pleasant when known; comfortable while known

examples.text: sukhā kho, āvuso visākha, vedanā ṭhitisukhā vipariṇāmadukkhā. dukkhā vedanā ṭhitidukkhā vipariṇāmasukhā. adukkham'asukhā vedanā ñāṇasukhā aññāṇadukkhā'ti.

28887.meaning1: to be destroyed by understanding; to be eliminated by knowledge

28888.meaning1: grounds for knowledge; basis for understanding

examples.text: catucattārīsaṃ vo, bhikkhave, ñāṇavatthūni desessāmi, taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmī'ti. evaṃ, bhante'ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.

28889.meaningLit: discourse on the grounds for knowledge

28890.meaning1: saying that one knows; declaration of understanding

examples.text: ñāṇavādaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu vadamāno, jānām'imaṃ dhammaṃ, passām'imaṃ dhamman'ti. tañ'ce, āvuso, bhikkhuṃ lobho abhibhuyya tiṭṭhati, doso abhibhuyya tiṭṭhati
imesaṃ, bho gotama, ubhinnaṃ ñāṇavādānaṃ ubhinnaṃ aññam'aññaṃ vipaccanīkavādānaṃ ko saccaṃ āha ko musā'ti?

28891.meaning1: knowledge of the doctrine; doctrinal understanding

examples.text: so kho ahaṃ, aggivessana, tāvataken'eva oṭṭhapahatamattena lapitalāpanamattena ñāṇavādañ'ca vadāmi theravādañ'ca, jānāmi passāmī'ti ca paṭijānāmi, ahañ'c'eva aññe ca.

katame pañca dhammā uppādetabbā? pañca ñāṇiko sammāsamādhi, ayaṃ samādhi paccuppannasukho c'eva āyatiñ'ca sukhavipāko'ti paccattaṃ'y'eva ñāṇaṃ uppajjati. ayaṃ samādhi ariyo nirāmiso'ti paccattaññ'eva ñāṇaṃ uppajjati.

28894.synonym: dhīra, nipaka, pañña, paññava, paññavant, paññāṇavant, paññāvant, paṇḍita, matimant, matīmant, mutimant, mutīmant, viññujātika, viññū, vibhāvī, sapañña, sappañña, sumedha, sumedhasa

examples.text: cakk'ānuvattako thero, mahāñāṇī samāhito, pathav'āp'aggisamāno, na rajjati na dussati.
pare micchāñāṇī bhavissanti, mayam'ettha sammāñāṇī bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.

28896.meaning1: arising of understanding; coming forth of knowledge

examples.text: saññā kho, poṭṭhapāda, paṭhamaṃ uppajjati, pacchā ñāṇaṃ, saññ'uppādā ca pana ñāṇ'uppādo hoti. so evaṃ pajānāti, idappaccayā kira me ñāṇaṃ udapādī'ti.
yesañ'ca kho etaṃ bhante ñātaṃ diṭṭhaṃ viditaṃ sacchikataṃ phassitaṃ paññāya, nikkaṅkhā te tattha nibbicikicchā
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhu, rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ daḷh'uddhāpaṃ daḷhapākāratoraṇaṃ chadvāraṃ. tatr'assa dovāriko paṇḍito byatto medhāvī, aññātānaṃ nivāretā, ñātānaṃ pavesetā.
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, asappuriso ñāto hoti yasassī. so iti paṭisañcikkhati, ahaṃ kho'mhi ñāto yasassī, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū appaññātā app'esakkhā'ti.

atha kho sabhiyo paribbājako tassā devatāya santike te pañhe uggahetvā ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā saṅghino gaṇino gaṇ'ācariyā ñātā yasassino titthakarā sādhusammatā bahujanassa… te upasaṅkamitvā te pañhe pucchati.

28899.meaning1: kin; kinsman; relative; relation; family member

examples.text: na taṃ mātā pitā kayirā, aññe vā'pi ca ñātakā, sammāpaṇihitaṃ cittaṃ, seyyaso naṃ tato kare.
so ñātakehi nīyamāno appatvā'va ñātake antarāmagge kālaṃ karoti. evarūpo'pi, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco yodh'ājīvo hoti. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, dutiyo yodh'ājīvo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ.
